test_serialize_deserialize: test that biomechanics gym environments can be pickled and unpickled with identical observations and seeds
run_gym_make: run gym.make with a biomechanics environment ID and seed to create a MuJoCo environment instance
test_get_obs_dict: test the get_obs_dict method on a biomechanics environment to retrieve observation key-value pairs
test_get_reward_dict: test the get_reward_dict method on a biomechanics environment to retrieve reward key-value pairs
test_env_step: test stepping a biomechanics environment with a zero action vector via env.step
